identity.title: CI: eliminate repeated hosted workspace coverage compiles

values.goal: Eliminate repeated Azure-backed hosted workspace coverage compilation while preserving required adl-coverage semantics.
values.required_outcome: The PR full-coverage hosted path compiles the instrumented workspace at most once and the required aggregate check only verifies, merges, and enforces coverage from producer summaries.
authority_boundary: CI topology and contract-test behavior only.
No runtime production behavior, optional validation dispatch, cloud provisioning, or main-worktree edits.
GitHub lifecycle writes must use typed v2 routes; raw gh is not allowed.
